Population increased in Salford

The estimated population of Salford in 2024 was 294,348 usual residents, a rise of 2.5% since 2023.

This meant that Salford's rate of population change placed it among the 10 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Salford increased by 8.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, Salford was also among the 10% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Salford

The average (median) age fell to 33.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Salford has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Salford is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Salford's population of 294,348 usual residents was made up of:

  • 57,023 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.4%)
  • 200,381 people aged 16 to 64 years, (68.1%)
  • 36,944 people aged 65 years and over, (12.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Salford has a lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (12.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Salford, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Salford
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Salford, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 1,188 people (0.4%). In total, there were 3,478 births and 2,290 deaths in Salford.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 630 (0.2%). There were 27,908 people entering the area and 27,278 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Salford's population of 5,328 (1.9%) as a result of 7,957 people entering the area and 2,629 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Salford was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Salford in mid-2023 is 287,178.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 2,220 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 852 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 3,072 people.
